prompt: Which sentence is true about every square?

choices.label: Every square is also a rectangle.
Every rectangle is also a square.
A square is not a quadrilateral.

hint: A rectangle is a four-sided shape with four right angles. Does a square have those?

hints.text: A rectangle is a four-sided shape with four right angles. Does a square have those?
A square has four right angles AND four equal sides — it meets the rectangle rules and then some.
Every square is a rectangle, but a long skinny rectangle is not a square.

explanation: A rectangle is any quadrilateral with four right angles.
A square has four right angles, so it passes that test — every square is a rectangle.
It does not work backwards: a $3$ by $8$ rectangle has four right angles but its sides are not all equal, so it is not a square.
Choices C and D are simply false: squares are four-sided and full of right angles.

alternativeExplanations.title: Think of nested boxes
steps: Quadrilaterals is the biggest box; rectangles sit inside it; squares sit inside rectangles.
Being in a smaller box means you are also in every bigger one.
